fusions.name: Plunging Leap
fusions.desc: Leaps you to a target up to 7 tiles away and lands in a crushing splash that deals 16 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Far-Flung Droplet
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at full reach.

fusions.name: Springing Film
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a skin of water that absorbs the next 14 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Landing Spatter
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a droplet springs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
